operation.body:
## Goal
Record the owner's Goal #19 design adoption in project documentation and implement the first fake-source-only inventory normalization boundary for the seven fixed sysctl fields. Deliver one PR; keep the CLI synthetic-only.

## Acceptance criteria
- Synchronize decisions, requirements, architecture, design-review and development documentation with explicit owner approval 1: A in Project #1 comment 6897940905, preserving the exact design reference and all safety/human-review gates.
- Add a typed seven-field allowlist with fixed selector, source ID, capacity and units. An injected read-only reader has no arbitrary selector/setter interface; ship no native implementation and invoke no telemetry.
- Normalize synthetic byte responses with explicit returned lengths: reject failed/partial, oversized, wrong-width, unterminated, embedded-NUL, nonprintable, non-ASCII and empty strings. Decode Intel little-endian uint64 memory and positive signed 32-bit CPU counts without unsafe pointer casts or floating-point conversion. Failure diagnostics use fixed reason codes, never source dumps. Preserve exact UInt64 JSON numbers, including values above 2^53.
- Fake-reader tests verify every selector/capacity, isolated calls with no retries/fallback, failure status mapping, string/numeric boundary cases, gap/null/provenance and integer encoding. Retain all existing fixture/CLI/adapter checks and default live refusal.
- Document no OS-call, worker, deadline, persistence or live-report integration guarantee. Complete integrated review, signed PR, CI and mandatory human review/merge handoff; no agent merge for input-validation changes.

## Constraints
Parent Project #1; local self-correcting-review and conditional Low-risk auto-merge. Owner adopted Goal #19 design on 2026-11-15 and directed synthetic/fake-source validation first, one goal at a time. Approved design implementation needs no repeated design approval; input validation is High risk under security policy, so human review/merge remains mandatory. No hardware tests, privileged operations, workloads, SMC writes, telemetry invocation, live adapters or background automation. Preserve private reusable workflow, historical transcription and unrelated .gitlab/.
Risks: raw buffer length/type confusion, unsigned precision loss, fake results mistaken for live evidence, read-only interface mistaken for proof of native call safety. Decision queue: no blocking choices; exact C calls, errno mapping, OS-version/CPU/thermal/power adapters and native/IPC review remain future slices.

## Out of scope
Native/SMC calls, worker/process/IPC implementation, deadlines/scheduling integration, report persistence or live CLI/report wiring, real capture, privilege, workload, dependencies/toolchains/CI changes, GUI/control/recovery and a second goal.

## Relevant context
Owner decision https://github.com/szymoniwacz/mac-thermal-control/issues/1#issuecomment-6897940905; docs/public-telemetry-adapter-review.md at 371055d742b05ecccc0572549c192be6f3f2f4de; R-001 discovery specification; .ai/project/ and .ai/docs/project-requirements.md. Goals 2,7,9,11,13,15,17,19 are terminal via merged PRs 3,8,10,12,14,16,18,20. Main CI 43702946578 passed; no outstanding deferred owner validation.
Rollback: reviewed forward revert PR; this slice creates no report store or deployed service.
